findings.highlight: So I just kind of blurted something out, as if it were a natural thing to say.
findings.evidenceJa: 当然、俺の台詞なんて決まっていた
findings.governingReading: 当然、俺の台詞なんて決まっていた says his reply was of course already settled, presenting taking over the ideal as an inevitable response.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s already-determined response becomes something blurted out.

findings.highlight: The bold promise made my father smile.
findings.evidenceJa: そう言い切る前に、父は微笑った
findings.governingReading: そう言い切る前に fixes the smile before Shirou finishes; the next sentence says Kiritsugu needs no continuation.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu smiles before the vow is completed, rather than after hearing the promise.

findings.highlight: His face said everything I needed to know.
findings.evidenceJa: 続きなんて聞くまでもないっていう顔だった
findings.governingReading: 続きなんて聞くまでもない describes the father’s expression as saying he need not hear the continuation.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu not needing the rest of Shirou’s words becomes his face telling Shirou everything.

findings.highlight: he was glad to have been able to rescue at least one person.
findings.evidenceJa: 一人だけでも助けられて救われた
findings.governingReading: Being able to save even one person brought Kiritsugu relief described as being saved himself.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu's gratitude remains, but his own relief through saving Shirou becomes simple gladness at the rescue. The change weakens the passage's pairing of rescued child and relieved rescuer.
